query:
SELECT 
  ei.evaluatorStudentId, 
  ei.evaluatedStudentId,
  ei.knowledge, 
  ei.cooperation, 
  ei.participation, 
  ei.organization, 
  ei.rolePerformance,
  ei.totalScore,
  s_evaluator.name as evaluator_name,
  s_evaluated.name as evaluated_name,
  ss_evaluator.absent as evaluator_absent
FROM evaluation_items ei
JOIN students s_evaluator ON ei.evaluatorStudentId = (SELECT ss2.studentId FROM session_students ss2 WHERE ss2.id = ei.evaluatorStudentId)
JOIN students s_evaluated ON ei.evaluatedStudentId = (SELECT ss3.studentId FROM session_students ss3 WHERE ss3.id = ei.evaluatedStudentId)
JOIN session_students ss_evaluator ON ss_evaluator.id = ei.evaluatorStudentId
WHERE ei.evaluatedStudentId IN (
  SELECT ss.id FROM session_students ss WHERE ss.studentId = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE enrollment = '23211323')
);
